title: Arms Sales Notification
items_summary: Correction to notice document 2025-09363 (pages 22249-22253, May 27, 2025 issue): images on pages 22250 and 22251 should not have appeared.
summary: This is a correction notice from the DSCA, published June 9, 2025, stating that images on pages 22250 and 22251 of the May 27, 2025 notice (document 2025-09363) should not have appeared. The correction notice itself contains no sale details, purchasing country, dollar values, or equipment lists. The transmittal number shown in the header is 24-0B.
